notes: §1985:X.5.4.2 prints the statement as the two words 'EXIT PROGRAM' with no phrase; 2023 adds RAISING. exitStatement parses EXIT PROGRAM [raisingPhrase], VisitRaisingPhrase refuses every RAISING form at 85 (COBOL0879: EXCEPTION name, identifier, LAST EXCEPTION), any other trailing word (PROGRAM again, GIVING, RETURNING) is COBOL2269, VisitExitStatement gates a statement after EXIT PROGRAM in its sequence (COBOL0900, §1985:X.5.4.3 SR1) and GOBACK is COBOL0880; BindExit binds the bare form to BoundExitProgram. Probed at 85: EXIT PROGRAM inside IF in a called program returned at once, the non-initial callee kept its counter across calls and the INITIAL one restarted it; the witness runs EXIT PROGRAM in a program no one called and continues to the next statement (§1985:X.5.4.4 GR1).

next.reason: 1985: "EXIT PROGRAM"; 2023: "EXIT PROGRAM [RAISING {EXCEPTION exception-name-1 | identifier-1 | LAST EXCEPTION}]". 2023 Format 2 keeps EXIT PROGRAM but adds an optional RAISING phrase the 1985 format lacked, so more programs are accepted. 2023 also marks this format archaic.
